# raff_app_custom_domain (Resource)

Adds a custom domain to a Raff Apps web service. Create the CNAME and TXT records it returns; verification and the TLS certificate then run automatically.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The hostname, such as `www.example.com`.
- `service_id` (String) ID of the web app (`raff_app_service.<name>.id`).

### Read-Only

- `cname_target` (String) Point the domain's CNAME record here.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Verification and certificate status.
- `status_message` (String)
- `verification_txt_name` (String) Name of the TXT record that proves you own the domain.
- `verification_txt_value` (String) Value of that TXT record.
